verdict: Meta is carrying all lead volume; Google Ads and intake need immediate attention.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 32 leads at a cost of $125.02 per lead — all 32 came from Meta, which spent $1,421 to deliver them. Google Ads consumed $2,581 over the same period and recorded only 2 conversions, meaning that budget is not producing leads at an acceptable rate; we are auditing the conversion tracking and campaign structure now to confirm whether the issue is measurement or performance. Separately, 113 leads have entered your pipeline this period but none have progressed to a booked appointment, which points to a gap in the intake process rather than the ads — we are working with your team to identify where leads are going quiet. You can expect a clearer picture on both the Google Ads attribution and the intake flow within the next reporting period.
